hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Lower cone
function: The tapered composite ring that wedges the lower slips outward as the plug is compressed.

tabs.overview: Cone angle sets the setting force needed and the holding force gained; composite so it mills quickly.
tabs.safety: None beyond the plug as a whole.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
